ops.quote: Discriminative self-supervised learning allows training models on any random group of internet images
we question if using this ability, we can learn any salient and more representative information
we extensively study and validate our model performance on over 50 benchmarks
we scale our model size to dense 10 billion parameters to avoid underfitting
the resulting model, not only captures well semantic information
we discover that such model is more robust, more fair, less harmful and less biased
it also captures information about artistic style and learns salient information
we train models on billions of random images without any data pre-processing
